Synopsis:
A group of bandits in an abandoned chapel - they're hoping to loot the place and are a little on edge. Abandoned chapels often have traps or undead guardians. they're startled by a loud noise from one of the side-chambers. The roof just caved in, and the bandit are trying to figure out a plan of action. What they don't know is that the roof collapse was caused by the players who just broke in.

context: A small crew of bandits has been rifling through an abandoned chapel and are already jumpy — they expect traps or restless dead in places like this. A sudden crash from a side chamber reveals that part of the roof just caved in, and the group is scrambling to decide whether to investigate, set an ambush, or fall back. Andorn is the pragmatic one trying to keep everyone calm and coordinate, Barton pushes for a quick, aggressive response, and Mari is frightened and convinced something alive is moving in the rubble. Unknown to them, the collapse was caused by the player characters who just forced their way into the ruin; the bandits assume the danger is local (trap/undead/hidden defenders) and worry someone might be trapped.
